title: A zone's quests, by level
sql:
SELECT q.id, n.name AS title, q.level, q.min_level
FROM quest q
JOIN name n ON n.kind = 'quest' AND n.id = q.id AND n.locale = 'enUS'
WHERE q.zone_id = 12 -- Elwynn Forest
ORDER BY q.level, q.id

title: A creature's name in every language
sql:
SELECT locale, name, female, source
FROM name
WHERE kind = 'creature' AND id = 448 -- Hogger
ORDER BY locale

title: Rares and their zones
sql:
SELECT c.id, n.name, c.min_level, a.name AS zone, count(*) AS spawns
FROM creature c
JOIN name n ON n.kind = 'creature' AND n.id = c.id AND n.locale = 'enUS'
JOIN spawn s ON s.kind = 'creature' AND s.entity_id = c.id AND s.area_id IS NOT NULL
LEFT JOIN name a ON a.kind = 'area' AND a.id = s.area_id AND a.locale = 'enUS'
WHERE c.rank IN (2, 4)
GROUP BY c.id, s.area_id
ORDER BY c.min_level

title: What drops an item, best odds first
sql:
SELECT l.kind, l.source_id, n.name AS dropped_by, l.chance, l.source
FROM loot l
LEFT JOIN creature c ON l.kind = 'creature' AND c.loot_id = l.source_id
LEFT JOIN name n ON n.kind = 'creature' AND n.id = c.id AND n.locale = 'enUS'
WHERE l.item_id = 2589 -- Linen Cloth
ORDER BY l.chance DESC
LIMIT 50

title: Quests without a French title
sql:
SELECT q.id, n.name
FROM quest q
JOIN name n ON n.kind = 'quest' AND n.id = q.id AND n.locale = 'enUS'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM name f WHERE f.kind = 'quest' AND f.id = q.id AND f.locale = 'frFR')
ORDER BY q.id

title: Books and their pages
sql:
SELECT r.kind, r.id, n.name AS title, count(p.idx) AS pages
FROM readable r
LEFT JOIN name n ON n.kind = r.kind AND n.id = r.id AND n.locale = 'enUS'
LEFT JOIN readable_page p ON p.kind = r.kind AND p.id = r.id AND p.locale = 'enUS'
GROUP BY r.kind, r.id
ORDER BY pages DESC

title: Where the rows come from
sql:
SELECT 'quest' AS tbl, source, count(*) AS n FROM quest GROUP BY source
UNION ALL SELECT 'creature', source, count(*) FROM creature GROUP BY source
UNION ALL SELECT 'object', source, count(*) FROM object GROUP BY source
UNION ALL SELECT 'item', source, count(*) FROM item GROUP BY source
UNION ALL SELECT 'spawn', source, count(*) FROM spawn GROUP BY source
UNION ALL SELECT 'name', source, count(*) FROM name GROUP BY source
ORDER BY tbl, n DESC
